completions.completed_label: Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis (HLH) with central nervous system involvement
completions.reason: The patient developed seizures and lost consciousness, had abnormal CSF findings, and leptomeningeal thickening/enhancement on MRI, indicating CNS involvement in HLH.
support_spans: Later during hospitalization, the patient developed seizures and lost consciousness.

Cerebrospinal fluid analysis showed:       - Nucleated cells count: 454 (0-5) ×106/L, with 75% mononuclear cells       - Protein level: 4001 (150-450) mg/L       - Normal glucose and chlorides       - Opening pressure: over 300 mm H2O
Leptomeninges thickening and enhancement observed in contrast-enhanced T1 weighted image
